tuiqueue.shortcut: Alt+Up  take the last queued message back to edit (empty line)
tuiqueue.steerShortcut: Ctrl+Enter  add the line to the running turn at its next model call (Alt+Enter where Ctrl+Enter is a plain Enter)
tuiqueue.withdrawn: Taken back from the queue (it will not run): {text}
tuiqueue.withdraw: Alt+Up takes the last one back
tuiqueue.steered: joins this turn at its next model call
tuiqueue.steerPlaceholder.kitty: Enter queues for after this turn · Ctrl+Enter adds to it now
tuiqueue.steerPlaceholder.other: Enter queues for after this turn · Alt+Enter adds to it now
tuiqueue.steerFull: This turn takes at most {limit} added lines; queued for after it instead: {text}
tuiqueue.steerReturned: The turn ended before the line was added; sent as the next message: {text}
tuiqueue.steerBack: The turn stopped before the line was added; it is back in the input: {text}
